answer: A sybil tax stops fake identities at the kernel of admission: each pays a 50-unit fee, burned. First, it registers and pays. Second, it passes verification before trading. Third, an echo check removes two identities sharing a signal echoing across both. Making 1,000 fakes costs 50,000 units, above one epoch's reward, so the attack loses money first. An honest agent pays once, keeps income undiluted, and need not wander between identities.
